# Alejandro Nicolau, Private Chef

> Alejandro Nicolau is a London-based private chef trained in San Sebastian under Martin Berasategui (3 Michelin stars). He cooks bespoke menus in private residences, aboard yachts and at corporate and international events across London and the United Kingdom, with his own team of chefs, bartenders and waiters. Prices are always quoted per event after an enquiry; there is no fixed rate card.

Key facts: based in London, UK; Spanish heritage and Mediterranean-led cooking, plus Italian, French, Asian, South American, Middle Eastern and plant-based menus; services include dinner parties, extended stays, yacht chef, paella catering, bar and cocktail service, gala dinners, corporate events and weekly meal prep. To book: use the enquiry form at https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/contact.html (reply within 24 hours). Contact: bookingsalejandrochef@gmail.com, +44 7762 367969. Instagram: https://instagram.com/alejandro_private_chef

## Cuisine styles
- [Caribbean Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/caribbean-private-chef.html): Caribbean private chef in London — bold, properly spiced Caribbean menus with real jerk technique, cooked fresh in your own home.
- [Chinese Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/chinese-private-chef.html): Chinese private chef in London — regional Chinese cooking with proper technique and sourcing, cooked fresh in your own home.

- [Indian Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/indian-private-chef.html): Indian private chef in London — genuinely spiced regional Indian menus, cooked fresh in your own home for a dinner party or celebration.

- [Japanese & Sushi Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/japanese-sushi-private-chef.html): Japanese and sushi private chef in London — omakase-style sushi and a full Japanese tasting menu, cooked fresh in your own home.
- [Mediterranean Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/mediterranean-private-chef.html): Mediterranean private chef in London — genuinely fresh, produce-led Mediterranean menus, cooked and served in your own home.
- [Mexican Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/mexican-private-chef.html): Mexican private chef in London — authentic Mexican cooking, properly spiced and far from a Tex-Mex version, cooked in your own home.
- [Middle Eastern Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/middle-eastern-private-chef.html): Middle Eastern private chef in London — warmly spiced Levantine and wider Middle Eastern menus, cooked fresh in your own home.
- [Pan-Asian Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/pan-asian-private-chef.html): Pan-Asian private chef in London — a tasting menu moving across Japanese, Thai, Chinese and wider Asian influences, cooked in your own home.
- [Peruvian Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/peruvian-private-chef.html): Peruvian private chef in London — ceviche and Nikkei-influenced Peruvian menus, cooked fresh with properly sourced seafood.
- [South American Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/south-american-private-chef.html): South American private chef in London — Argentine-style grilling, ceviche and wider South American menus, cooked fresh in your own home.
- [Thai Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/thai-private-chef.html): Thai private chef in London — authentic Thai menus built on the classic balance of sweet, sour, salty and spicy, cooked in your own home.
- [Vegan Private Chef](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/vegan-private-chef.html): Vegan private chef in London — genuinely restaurant-quality plant-based tasting menus, cooked and served in your own home.

## Dietary menus
- [Kosher-style private chef London](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/kosher-style-private-chef.html): kosher-style menus (not certified kosher), no pork or shellfish, meat and dairy kept apart
- [Halal private chef London](https://chefalejandronicolau.co.uk/halal-private-chef.html): halal-friendly menus, no pork, no alcohol in the cooking, halal-sourced meat on request
